news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro (NASDAQ:CLPT) Trading Up 8.3% -- Here's Why
news.summary: CLPT shares rose 8.3% to $16.43 intraday in a technical bounce off 200-day EMA support near $15, extending the recovery from the post-earnings selloff though volume was 75% below average and shares remain well off the 52-week high of $30.10.

news.headline: Conway Capital Management discloses new $1.66 million stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: A Q2 13F filing showed Conway Capital Management bought 92,975 CLPT shares worth about $1.66 million, adding to a string of institutional filings that have shown continued accumulation despite the post-earnings share-price weakness.

news.headline: MAK Capital group discloses 7.8% ownership in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund, MAK Capital One, and Michael A. Kaufman reported beneficial ownership of 2,375,861 CLPT shares (7.8%) as of July 27, 2026, up from a 6.3% stake disclosed in May, signaling continued accumulation by the activist-leaning investor.

news.headline: Wall Street Zen cuts ClearPoint Neuro to "Strong Sell" after Q2 miss
news.summary: Wall Street Zen downgraded CLPT from "Sell" to "Strong Sell" on August 8, citing execution risk after the Q2 revenue miss and guidance cut, even as other sell-side desks (Lake Street, Stifel) kept bullish ratings alongside lower price targets.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Unveils Five-Pillar $500M Strategy
news.summary: Q2 revenue came in at $10.9M (+18% YoY, boosted by the acquired IRRAflow portfolio) but missed the $12.73M consensus by about $1.8M, prompting a cut to FY26 guidance to $48-52M (from $52-56M) and a roughly 15% after-hours share drop to about $13; management laid out a five-pillar plan targeting $500M in long-term revenue and flagged Lake Street/Stifel target cuts to $25 and $22, respectively, the same week.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA RMAT Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: Aspen Neuroscience's cell therapy sasineprocel (ANPD001) for Parkinson's disease, delivered via ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula, received FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy designation, potentially accelerating its path to approval; Aspen has since dosed patients in cohorts 3 and 4 of its Phase I/IIa ASPIRO trial, bringing the total to 15.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro has historically reported Q3 results in early November (Q3 2025 was reported November 6, 2025); an exact 2026 date has not yet been formally announced as of late August 2026.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission (read-through)
catalysts.detail: uniQure intends to submit a BLA for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease), delivered via ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula, in Q3 2026 after the FDA agreed 3-year Phase I/II data (75% slowing of cUHDRS progression vs. external controls) could support accelerated approval under RMAT/Breakthrough designations; timeline remains on track as of late August 2026, and a filing would validate ClearPoint's gene-therapy delivery ecosystem and its higher per-procedure revenue ($15K-$25K).

catalysts.label: Biologics and Drug Delivery segment return to growth
catalysts.detail: Management guided that new services revenue from the recently acquired ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) preclinical facility (a new 30,000-sq-ft site now fully transitioned into) is expected to return the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to sequential growth in Q3 2026.

catalysts.label: Partner clinical data readouts
catalysts.detail: Company has flagged roughly 10 partner clinical/regulatory milestones (data readouts, RMAT/breakthrough designations, filings) expected across its 60+ biopharma partner base, including continued dosing updates from Aspen Neuroscience's ASPIRO trial.

catalysts.label: First GLP IND-enabling study at CAL
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's newly acquired Torrey Pines preclinical lab (ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories) has its first GLP statement-of-work study slated for completion in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: Potential first commercial cell/gene therapy approvals
catalysts.detail: Management points to potential commercial approvals of partner cell and gene therapies administered via ClearPoint's platform by end-2027, underpinning the long-term $500M revenue strategy.

pulse: CLPT is stabilizing after its post-Q2-earnings plunge, bouncing roughly 8% off 200-day support in late August to the mid-$15 to mid-$16 range, still well below the $30.10 52-week high, amid a fractured analyst picture (Lake Street/Stifel cut targets to $25/$22 while staying bullish, but Wall Street Zen slapped a Strong Sell on August 8; consensus sits around Hold/$25.67). Institutional accumulation continues underneath the volatility -- MAK Capital raised its stake to 7.8% in mid-August, Conway Capital disclosed a fresh $1.66M position, and short interest has been ticking down (roughly 2.4% of float) -- while cash stood at $29.4M as of June 30. The bull case still rests on the partner pipeline: Aspen Neuroscience's FDA RMAT designation and continued ASPIRO dosing, plus the on-track uniQure AMT-130 BLA (Q3 2026), validate the five-pillar, $500M long-term revenue strategy management unveiled alongside the guidance cut, with the Biologics segment expected to return to growth in Q3 as the CAL lab ramps.
